sn22.150:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati. kiṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti?
sn22.150:1.4: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn22.150:1.5: vedanāya sati vedanaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn22.150:1.7: saṅkhāresu sati saṅkhāre upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn22.150:1.8: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn22.150:1.12: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn22.150:1.14: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti?
sn22.150:1.21: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn22.150:1.23: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti?
sn22.150:1.25: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati …pe… viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati. nibbindaṃ virajjati …pe…
